description: Template for private, realistic Stage 5 model-selection runs. Copy to vision_workload.local.json and point each case at local images that are not committed. Keep this case set fixed across candidates.

cases.prompt: Identify the visible error, quote the important error text exactly, and explain what is directly visible versus what you infer.
Read the important terminal/editor text and identify the concrete problem shown. Do not invent text that is not visible.
Describe the important UI state, controls, labels, and any warning/error text. Distinguish exact visible text from interpretation.
Extract the important labeled information from this lecture slide and answer the question using only what is visible.
Describe the labeled components and answer the question implied by the engineering diagram using only visible evidence.
Read this chart carefully. State the requested values/trend and preserve labels and numbers exactly where relevant.
Read the requested row/column relationship from this table and preserve important values exactly.
Read the important fields from this photographed document. Preserve numbers and identifiers exactly and mention uncertainty caused by blur or perspective.
Describe the scene precisely. Separate directly visible facts from uncertain interpretation.
Read the important small UI/overlay state and answer the requested question without inventing hidden game state.
Compare the two screenshots and state the concrete visible changes. Do not claim changes that cannot be seen.
Use both images to answer the question. State which image supports each important fact and do not infer facts absent from both.
